summary: Wrote src/en/module_01/30-exercises.md: introduction plus all 15 exercises (e1-e15, 130 minutes, 7 one-star, 7 two-star, 1 three-star), each with a complete solution. Every number was recomputed with labpy.sh (e3 step counts by simulation, e4 gradients, e5 Bayes and two-stage figures, e6 AUC with sklearn, e7 MSE by Monte Carlo, e8 shrinkage and condition numbers, e13 full cross-validation script with per-fold differences, e14 self-contained regeneration of the Lab 5 data and refits). Added short verified demonstrations to e2 (rank and eigenvalues of the one-hot design), e9 (group leakage with k-NN, RMSE 0.44 vs 1.72) and e12 (k-NN 0.772 to 0.659, boosting 0.769 to 0.789). check.mjs reports no error in this file; the only ERROR is in 11-concepts-b.md line 993 (a stray dollar sign in KaTeX), another writer's file.
changes: e14(b): with the point's sigma multiplied by ten, c1 is 10.04 kPa (10.0447, chi2_nu 0.54, residual -0.69), not 10.05 as the plan says; dropping the point gives 10.04 as well. All other e14 numbers match the plan.

e12: the plan's claim that boosting loses much less was checked by simulation; boosting does not fall (0.769 to 0.789, about +0.02 in four seeds), so the solution says it does not fall and does not explain the small rise.

e13: boosting beats SVR in 5 of 5 folds on Friedman #1 (mean difference 0.059, 3.5 standard errors, caveat that folds are dependent); on diabetes ridge vs SVR is not supported (0.9 standard errors); boosting minus ridge there is 2.1 standard errors with ridge better in 4 of 5 folds. The solution words the learning-curve remark as a test to run, not as a result.

e5(c): added that independence errors cut both ways (combined recall above 0.81 if both miss the same cracks; precision below 0.948 if both flag the same sound parts), and a balanced-test-set precision of 0.97 for (d).
e3(c): added the asymptotic step count (kappa/2)ln 10^6 = 173 as a check.
issues: node tools/check.mjs --module 1 --lang en reports one ERROR, in src/en/module_01/11-concepts-b.md line 993 (KaTeX: stray dollar sign before the E_D expectation of f-hat); not my file, not edited.

The solutions link to #s12, #lab3 and #lab5 sections that other writers have not yet produced (checker warnings only). e14 and e15 describe Lab 5 only through the plan (check_inputs refusals, misread-as-tension figures), as Lab 5 was not written when this part was finished; e14 regenerates the data in its own code so it stands alone.
Timings printed in the e13 output are from this machine and will differ.
